sloka: ततः प्रवर्त्यताम् यज्ञः सर्वे समधितिष्ठत ।एवम् उक्त्वा महर्षयः संजह्रुः ताः क्रियाः तदा ॥१-६०-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ pravartyatām yajñaḥ sarve samadhitiṣṭhata ।evam uktvā maharṣayaḥ saṁjahruḥ tāḥ kriyāḥ tadā ॥1-60-8॥

translations.english: The maharshis having resolved performed their respective activities relating to the sacrifice. The brilliant Viswamitra acted as the chief officiating priest.
